```yaml
name: Required Checks

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  merge_group:

jobs:
  check-workflows:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Verify critical workflows have merge_group trigger
        run: |
          # List of critical workflow files that must have merge_group trigger
          critical_workflows=(
            ".github/workflows/lints.yml"
            ".github/workflows/build.yml"
            ".github/workflows/vm.yml"
            ".github/workflows/cli.yml"
            ".github/workflows/primitives.yml"
            ".github/workflows/sdk.yml"
            ".github/workflows/recursion.yml"
            ".github/workflows/extension-tests.yml"
            ".github/workflows/riscv.yml"
            ".github/workflows/guest-lib-tests.yml"
            ".github/workflows/benchmarks.yml"
            ".github/workflows/benchmarks-execute.yml"
            ".github/workflows/docs.yml"
            ".github/workflows/native-compiler.yml"
          )

          failed=0
          for workflow in "${critical_workflows[@]}"; do
            if [ ! -f "$workflow" ]; then
              echo "::error::Workflow file $workflow not found"
              failed=1
              continue
            fi
            
            if ! grep -q "merge_group:" "$workflow"; then
              echo "::error::Workflow $workflow is missing merge_group trigger"
              failed=1
            else
              echo "::notice::Workflow $workflow has merge_group trigger"
            fi
          done

          if [ $failed -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "::error::One or more critical workflows are missing merge_group triggers"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          echo "All critical workflows have merge_group triggers configured"
```
